outcome: Hemoglobin levels in the third trimester
Hemoglobin levels in the immediate postpartum period
cohort: 107 childbirths (55 vaginal and 52 caesarean) at the Hospital de Apoyo San Francisco in 2018.
finding: There was a significant difference in hemoglobin levels between the third trimester and postpartum period, with a greater decrease observed in women who underwent caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women who underwent caesarean delivery had a larger decrease in hemoglobin levels from the third trimester to postpartum (1.8 g/dL) compared to those who had a vaginal delivery (1.52 g/dL).
